title: ByteDance Seedance 2.5 Release: 30-Second Single-Take AI Video Starts Telling a Story

content_html:
ByteDance officially launched the Seedance 2.5 video generation model, doubling the single-video generation duration from 15 seconds to 30 seconds. The model will be gradually launched on Ji Meng AI and Dou Bao Professional Edition, and API services will also be integrated into Volcano Argo soon, opening up to multiple scenarios such as film, advertising, education, industrial manufacturing, and even autonomous driving.

The official said that Seedance 2.5 continues the unified multimodal audio-visual joint generation architecture, with core breakthroughs in the comprehensive improvement of long narrative capabilities, multimodal reference, and editing capabilities. In simple terms, AI videos are no longer just generating scattered clips, but can complete a complete creation with a beginning, middle, and end.

Organize multi-shot storytelling within 30 seconds, maintaining consistency through multiple extensions

In the official demonstration example, a clip of a singer performing in one shot fully presented the narrative logic: the camera moved from the gap of the red curtain to the warm backstage dressing room, the young female singer adjusted her earphones, staff reminded her to go on stage, then she walked through the passage and interacted with her partner, took the microphone, and finally stepped onto the stage—the camera pulled back to show the entire stadium, with the audience, lights, fluorescent sticks, and cheers all captured. The model can organize multiple logically connected shots such as setup, development, turning point, and conclusion within 30 seconds.

The multi-round extension capability is equally impressive—the model can continue to generate another 30 seconds based on an existing video, while maintaining the consistency of the main characters, scenes, visual style, as well as sounds and sound effects. In the official example, a boy ran out of the subway car holding a soccer ball, and the male lead chased and finally caught the boy, with the continuous action seamless and without any sense of detachment.

Feed 30 images and 10 videos at once, handling group storytelling effortlessly

Seedance 2.5 supports users to input up to 30 images, 10 video clips, and 10 audio clips as reference materials in one go. The model can comprehensively understand elements such as composition, scene, style, characters, and props in different materials, and accurately apply them to video generation according to instructions. In scenes with multiple people appearing together, it can simultaneously restore multiple characters' appearances and voices while keeping the main subjects stable—officially demonstrated 30-second music concert clip used a 16:9 horizontal screen with a cinematic realistic style, and the reference materials covered a pianist, a cellist, a violinist, a vocalist, an orchestra, a choir, and the audience. When AI video evolves from "special effect toys" to being able to handle complete narratives and group scheduling, the toolkit for short video creation may need to be rewritten again.

content_html_zh:
字节跳动正式推出Seedance 2.5视频生成模型，将单视频生成时长从15秒翻倍至30秒。 该模型将在极萌AI和豆宝专业版上逐步上线，API服务也将很快集成到Volcano Argo中，开放电影、广告、教育、工业制造、甚至自动驾驶等多个场景。

官方表示，Seedance 2.5延续了统一的多模态视听联合生成架构，核心突破在于长篇叙事能力、多模态参考、编辑能力的全面提升。 简单来说，AI视频不再只是生成零散的片段，而是可以完成一个有开头、中间、结尾的完整创作。

在 30 秒内组织多个镜头的故事讲述，通过多次扩展保持一致性

官方演示示例中，一段歌手表演的片段充分展现了叙事逻辑：镜头从红色幕布的缝隙移动到温暖的后台更衣室，年轻女歌手调整好耳机，工作人员提醒她上台，然后她走过通道与搭档互动，拿起麦克风，最后走上舞台——镜头拉回来，展现了整个体育场，观众、灯光、荧光棒、欢呼声都被捕捉到。 该模型可以在 30 秒内组织多个逻辑上相连的镜头，例如准备、发展、转折点和结论。

多轮扩展能力同样令人印象深刻——模型可以根据现有视频继续生成另外30秒，同时保持主要人物、场景、视觉风格以及声音和音效的一致性。 官方给出的例子中，一个男孩拿着足球从地铁车厢里跑出来，男主追赶并最终抓住了男孩，动作连绵不断，没有任何脱离感。

一次输入 30 张图像和 10 个视频，轻松处理小组讲故事

Seedance 2.5支持用户一次性输入最多30张图片、10个视频片段和10个音频片段作为参考资料。 该模型能够全面理解不同材质中的构图、场景、风格、人物、道具等元素，并根据指令准确应用到视频生成中。 在多人同时出现的场景中，可以同时还原多个人物的面貌和声音，同时保持主体稳定——官方演示的30秒音乐会片段采用16:9的横屏，具有电影写实风格，参考素材涵盖了钢琴家、大提琴家、小提琴家、歌手、管弦乐队、合唱团和观众。 当AI视频从“特效玩具”进化到能够处理完整的叙事和分组调度时，短视频创作的工具包可能需要重新重写。
